acceptance: A known-defect candidate can be reproduced against the base commit in an isolated runner without secrets.
A disguised new defect whose trigger is outside the cited lines is detected and blocks.
Activation is a reviewed owner decision.
context: Parked 2026-11-12 (owner decision): no base-branch reproduction design for now. Findings are model judgements, so reproducing one on the base means a second paid review compared against the first, and the need is unmeasured. Acceptance suspended until theseus-known-defects-pre-existing-20261109 reaches its reopen trigger (three owner adjudications of findings that were only pre-existing) and the owner reopens the design.
description: Owner chose reviewer judgement plus mechanical checks as the proof that a finding is pre-existing (theseus-known-defects-pre-existing-20261109). That accepts that uncited triggers (a new caller, input or config change, a guard removed elsewhere, a doc change) can pass as known. A stronger proof is to reproduce the defect against the base commit, which needs the same trusted isolated, secret-free runner as theseus-trusted-candidate-evaluator-20261109.
